package.name: wojtek_futurenav_bridge
package.description: Bridge between the FutureNav action server and the deployment ROS graph: subscribes the simulated D435 color feed and ground-truth TF, streams frames to POST /act, and executes the discrete VLN actions as /cmd_vel through the mid-level executor. Sim E2E testing only (issue #13); this package lives outside ros/src so ros/deploy.sh can never ship it.
